lines.japanese: まずいな、着替えと電話をしてたら遅くなってしまった。
lines.english: This was bad. Changing clothes and making that call had put me behind schedule.

lines.japanese: アレキサンダーの面々に、実は俺が学生（しかも玉泉日和子と同じ美空学園！）なんて知られたら面倒だからな。今まで鷲介がそうしてたように、私服を持ってきといてよかった。
lines.english: It would be awkward if the people at Alexander learned that I was actually a student—and at Misora Academy with Hiyoko Tamaizumi, no less. I was glad I had brought casual clothes, as Shusuke always did.

lines.japanese: 正直まだ統合の成果が万全じゃないから、しばらく休もうかとも思った。
lines.english: To be honest, the integration was still not functioning perfectly, and I had considered taking a little more time off.

lines.japanese: でも、ただでさえ二日連続で無断欠勤（厳密には欠勤じゃないんだけど）しちゃってるし、あんまり適当なのはせっかく働かせてくれてる軽部狩男氏に対して不義理が過ぎる。
lines.english: But I had already gone absent without notice two days running—though, strictly speaking, they had not been absences. Any more carelessness would be an inexcusable disservice to Karuo Karube, who had been good enough to employ me.

lines.japanese: というわけで、うん、今日は頑張ろう。試験運用中だからこそ、ひとと触れあう場に率先して自らを置くべきなのかもしれないしね。
lines.english: All right, then. I would do my best today. Perhaps a trial run was precisely when I ought to put myself proactively among other people.

lines.japanese: 「おはようございます！　羽田……あいや千歳ぬるぬる鷲介、今日もよろしくお願いしますコンバンワ！」
lines.english: “Good morning! Takashi Hane—no, wait, slimy Shusuke Chitose, reporting for duty. Pleasure working with you again tonight!”

lines.japanese: 「おお、鷲介。ちょうどいいところに来たな」
lines.english: “Ah, Shusuke. Excellent timing.”

lines.japanese: アレキサンダーの敷居を跨ぐや、軽部支店長がいい暇つぶしを見つけたとばかりに手招きしていた。ええと、ここでの俺は千歳鷲介だから、とりあえずヘラヘラ笑って軽めの敬語でも使ってればいいんだよな。
lines.english: The moment I crossed Alexander's threshold, Branch Manager Karube beckoned me over like a man who had just found a promising way to kill time. Let's see. Here, I was Shusuke Chitose. For now, I simply had to grin like an idiot and use casually polite language.

lines.japanese: 「お、おはよざーっすマスター！　すいません、連絡せずに二日も休んじゃって」
lines.english: “G-good mornin', boss! Sorry I took two days off without even calling.”

lines.japanese: 「構わん構わん。おまえの労働形態はもともと、任意の時間のみ入るというヘルプ業務だったはず。それよりもほらほら、早くよこせ」
lines.english: “No matter, no matter. You were originally engaged as relief staff who came in only at times of your own choosing. More importantly, come, come. Hand it over.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ。じゃあ。どうぞコレ」
lines.english: “Oh. Right. Here you are.”

lines.japanese: 「コンビニのレシートなどいらん。レイディオＫＫの脚本だ、今日は望月君も参加してくれるんだぞ」
lines.english: “I have no need of a convenience-store receipt. The script for Radio KK. Miss Mochizuki is joining us today too.”

lines.japanese: 軽部氏が手の甲でテーブルをばしばし叩く。ああ、なんだソレか。
lines.english: Karube slapped the table repeatedly with the back of his hand. Oh, he meant *that*.

lines.japanese: 軽部氏がソレを依頼したのは、実は鷲介にじゃなくて隼人にだった。しかし俺たちはもう鷲介でもあり隼人でもあるので、誰が頼まれようと同じことなのだ。
lines.english: Karube had actually assigned it to Hayato, not Shusuke. But now that we were Shusuke and Hayato both, it hardly mattered which of us had been asked.

lines.japanese: はいどうぞ。俺はゆうべ五分で作成しておいた適当な原稿を納品した。
lines.english: Here you are. I turned in the slapdash script I had written in five minutes the night before.

lines.japanese: 「いや済まんな。おまえも忙しいだろうが、きちんと台本を仕上げてきてくれるとは嬉しいぞ」
lines.english: “Forgive me. I know you're busy, but I'm glad you took the time to finish a proper script.”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　ああ、いえ……」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh, no...”

lines.japanese: 軽部氏にしては珍しく殊勝なことを言う。あ、もしかして、二日あけたのはこの原稿制作のせい、ってなことにしようとしてくれてるのかしら。
lines.english: That was uncommonly considerate of Karube. Oh. Was he trying to establish that the script was why I had been away for two days?

lines.japanese: ううっ、おおむねハタ迷惑だけどたまに気を利かせてくれるんだよなあ、このひと。いい上司だなあ。
lines.english: Ngh. Most of the time, the man was a public nuisance, but every so often he showed surprising tact. What a good boss.

lines.japanese: 「よし、やる気出てきたぞ。じゃ、すぐに着替えてきま──」
lines.english: “All right, I'm feeling motivated. I'll change and get right to—”

lines.japanese: <8>\「千歳さんっ！」
lines.english: “Mr. Chitose!”

lines.japanese: 「ひいいっ」
lines.english: “Eek!”

lines.japanese: 「そのときフロアに雷鳴のような声が響きわたった。民衆の心胆をことごとく寒からしめる、悪鬼のごときその声の主は……」
lines.english: “At that moment, a voice like thunder resounded across the floor. Its demonic timbre froze every civilian heart. And the owner of that voice was...”

lines.japanese: 「おい鷲介、モノローグ漏れてるぞ」
lines.english: “Shusuke, your internal narration is leaking out.”

lines.japanese: 「ああッ！？　恐怖のあまり奈落者の制御に不備が！」
lines.english: “Ahh!? Terror has compromised my control over the denizens of the Abyss!”

lines.japanese: 震えながら振りかえると、鷲介の──もとい俺の鬼教官・玉泉日和子が、そこに勇ましく仁王立ちしていた。
lines.english: Trembling, I turned. There stood Shusuke's—no, my own demonic instructor, Hiyoko Tamaizumi, planted with heroic firmness like a temple guardian.

lines.japanese: 相変わらずおっかない目をしていらっしゃる、と畏怖する反面、なんだこの年下のくせにクソ生意気な女は、と訝しむ俺もいた。
lines.english: One part of me regarded her fearsome gaze with the customary dread. Another wondered who this insufferably impertinent younger woman thought she was.

lines.japanese: 俺はあいだを取って、悠然とした態度で臨むことにした。
lines.english: I chose the middle course and met her with dignified composure.

lines.japanese: 「やあ、日和子さんのひとじゃないか。おはようございます、今日は眉間の皺が一段と深いですねブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Why, if it isn’t Miss Hiyoko... person. Good morning! That crease between your brows is deeper than ever. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: フランクに声をかけたら玉泉日和子の険しさが増した。
lines.english: My easygoing greeting made Hiyoko Tamaizumi's expression more severe.

lines.japanese: 腸的なところがゴロゴロしてトイレに駆けこみたい俺もいたが、ここで下手に出るんじゃねえと自らを鼓舞する俺もいた。
lines.english: One part of me felt his guts rumbling ominously and longed to run for the bathroom. Another urged me not to abase myself.

lines.japanese: ナメる側になるか、ナメられる側になるか、それは最初に目が合ったときすべて決まるんだよ。いや、そんなこと言ったってコレ全然最初じゃないし。うるせえ黙れ、女子供にヘコヘコしてんじゃねえ糞ワシ。
lines.english: Whether you're the one who looks down on people or the one they look down on is decided the first time your eyes meet. But this isn't remotely the first time. Shut up. Quit groveling to women and children, you shitbird.

lines.japanese: 「てめ、なにガン飛ばしてんだよ小娘」
lines.english: “What’re you glaring at, brat?”

lines.japanese: 「ああッ！　うそ、うそですいまの！　違うんですよ日和子さん、あのねっ──」
lines.english: “Ah! No, that was a lie! That's not what I meant! Hiyoko, listen—”

lines.japanese: 「千歳さん、この二日間なにをされていたんですか」
lines.english: “Mr. Chitose. What have you been doing for the past two days?”

lines.japanese: 「寝てた」
lines.english: “Sleeping.”

lines.japanese: その瞬間、玉泉日和子はあたかも喋るオランウータンでも前にしているかのようだった。俺は内心平謝りしながらも、一方で腰に両手を置いてフンと鼻を鳴らしていた。
lines.english: At that moment, Hiyoko Tamaizumi looked as though she had found herself face-to-face with a talking orangutan. Inwardly, I apologized profusely. Outwardly, I put both hands on my hips and snorted.

lines.japanese: 「待ちなさい玉泉君。鷲介には元から自由シフトという条件でのヘルプをお願いしていてな」
lines.english: “One moment, Miss Tamaizumi. Shusuke was engaged from the beginning as relief staff on a flexible schedule.”

lines.japanese: その様子を見て、あの軽部氏が珍しく助け船を出してくれた。彼がおちゃらけのひとつも挟まないところを見ると、玉泉日和子は本気で御立腹だったのだろうか。だとしたら悪いことをした。
lines.english: At this spectacle, even Karube unexpectedly threw me a lifeline. The fact that he did not insert a single joke suggested Hiyoko Tamaizumi might be genuinely angry. If so, I had done wrong.

lines.japanese: 「千歳さんの勤務形態については知ってますが、連絡がないのは困ります。毎日来てたひとに突然いなくなられては、店長も私も計算が狂っちゃうじゃないですか」
lines.english: “I understand Mr. Chitose’s working arrangement. But disappearing without a word is a problem. When someone who came in every day suddenly vanishes, it throws off the schedule for both the manager and me.”

lines.japanese: 「それに時間！　もうとっくに１８時を過ぎてるんですよ」
lines.english: “And look at the time! It's already well past six.”

lines.japanese: 玉泉日和子が指差した壁時計を確認すると、たしかに定刻から１５分ほどが経過していた。ううむ、そうだよなあ。軽部氏はフォローしてくれたけど、現場の人間に迷惑をかけたことは間違いないんだろうな。
lines.english: I checked the wall clock she pointed at. Indeed, fifteen minutes had passed since the appointed hour. Hmm. Karube had defended me, but I had unquestionably inconvenienced the people working here.

lines.japanese: 「最近は千歳さんの就業態度に感心していたのに、がっかりです」
lines.english: “I had recently begun to admire your attitude toward work, Mr. Chitose. I'm disappointed.”

lines.japanese: か、感心していた！？　うそおおおん、まままマジでえ！　マジであの鬼の玉泉教官が！？
lines.english: Sh-she'd been impressed!? No waaay! S-s-seriously? That demon had been impressed with me!?

lines.japanese: よし、ここは真面目に対応して名誉挽回するんだ。もう喋るんじゃない、内なるチンピラ小僧よ。俺は必死に隼人的な部分を抑え、代わりに彼女の歓心を得られるような人格を前面へ押しだした。
lines.english: Good. I would answer seriously and redeem my reputation. Do not speak again, delinquent brat within. I desperately suppressed the Hayato portion and pushed forward a personality more likely to win her favor.

lines.japanese: 「うぉんむ、うぉんむ。さようか、うぬは余に恋情の念を抱いておったのか」
lines.english: “Hrrm, hrrm. I see. So thou hast come to harbor amorous feeling for Us.”

lines.japanese: ああッ！　だからって、選りにも選ってそこで伽楼羅とか出てくんなよオイィィィ！　他のっ、他のやつ出てこい早く！
lines.english: No! Even then, why did it have to be *Karura* of all people!? Somebody else! Bring out somebody else, quickly!

lines.japanese: 「てー？　そんだらおれも、ひよねーちゃん好きだよ。だっておっぱい大きいんだも」
lines.english: “Huh? Then I like Hiyo too. 'Cause she's got big boobies.”

lines.japanese: 玉泉日和子はなにか別のものを見ていた。それはそれは空虚な瞳が、俺ではない何かを見つめていた。
lines.english: Hiyoko Tamaizumi was looking at something else. Those astonishingly empty eyes gazed upon something that was not me.

lines.japanese: 「おいおい鷲介、そんな公然と猥褻な言葉を口にするものじゃない。そういう言葉はゴム的なものに包むものだ」
lines.english: “Come, Shusuke. One mustn't utter obscene words so openly. Words of that sort ought to be sheathed in something rubbery.”

lines.japanese: 「店長は黙っていてください」
lines.english: “Manager, please be quiet.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「千歳さん……」
lines.english: “Mr. Chitose...”

lines.japanese: あわわわ……まずい、鷲介だ、鷲介的な意思を強く念じるんだ。俺は鷲介、俺は鷲介──
lines.english: Oh no... This was bad. Shusuke. I had to concentrate on Shusuke thoughts. I am Shusuke. I am Shusuke—

lines.japanese: 「先生、今日のパンツは何色ですか」
lines.english: “Miss, what color panties are you wearing today?”

lines.japanese: ──よし、やっと鷲介らしいことが言えたぞ。ふう、これでひと安心。
lines.english: Good. At last I had managed to say something Shusuke-like. Whew. That was a relief.

lines.japanese: 「……たのに」
lines.english: “...and yet...”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「マニュアル、全部読んでくれたから、信じてたのに……」
lines.english: “You read the whole manual. I trusted you...”

lines.japanese: <8>\　きゃあああーっ！
lines.english: Eeeeeek!

lines.japanese: 鬼教官の痛切な表情に、俺の中の五分の一が悲鳴をあげた。
lines.english: The demonic instructor's anguished expression made one-fifth of me scream.

lines.japanese: ま、待て、なにを動揺してるんだ俺。玉泉日和子には今まで好き勝手言われてきたんだし、丁度いい機会じゃないか、ブランニュー俺として今日からはやつと対等に渡りあって行くんだ！
lines.english: W-wait. Why was I shaken? Hiyoko Tamaizumi had said whatever she liked to me for ages. This was the perfect opportunity. As the brand-new me, I would meet her as an equal from this day forth!

lines.japanese: 後輩といえどもやつは年下だ、所詮バイト同士だし、まずもって敬語を使う必要がない。英里子さんだって、年上で先輩の紀奈子さん相手にタメ口じゃないか。友達ってそういうものだよね。そう、それだ。
lines.english: She might be my senior here, but she was younger than me. We were only fellow part-timers, and there was no reason to speak politely in the first place. Eriko spoke casually even to Kinako, who was older and her senior. That was how friendship worked. Yes. That was it.

lines.japanese: 「千歳さん」
lines.english: “Mr. Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はい、なんでしょう」
lines.english: “Y-yes? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 玉泉は右腕を目にあててぐいと一擦りした。タメ口でと決意したばかりの俺の返事は、なぜか敬語になっていた。
lines.english: Tamaizumi raised her right arm to her eyes and rubbed once, hard. Although I had just resolved to speak casually, my answer had somehow emerged in deferential language.

lines.japanese: 「この二日間で千歳さんの人格に重大な障害を及ぼす出来事があったことは理解できました――」
lines.english: “I understand that something occurred over these two days which has gravely impaired your personality—”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「――だからと言って、業務に支障をきたすような発言をしていいわけじゃありませんっ」
lines.english: “—but that does not permit you to say things that interfere with the work!”

lines.japanese: 「はいぃっ！」
lines.english: “Yes, ma'am!”

lines.japanese: 俺の背筋が意思とは無関係に反りかえった。くそっ、どんだけこの女に飼いならされてんだおまえ、アホか。まったくだ嘆かわしい、がるんがるーん！　俺の中の五分の二が猛った。
lines.english: My spine arched backward without consulting my will. Damn it, how thoroughly did you let this woman train you? Are you an idiot? A lamentable spectacle indeed—garun garuuun! Two-fifths of me raged.

lines.japanese: や、面目ないっす。それに対して五分の一が謝った。謝られたら仕方ない、俺は自分で自分を許すことにした。
lines.english: Yeah, sorry about that. One-fifth apologized in reply. Once I had apologized, there was nothing else for it, so I forgave myself.

lines.japanese: うんそうだよ、きっと話せば分かってくれる。だって彼女はこんなに綺麗な目をしてるんだもの。悪いひとなんてどこにもいないんだ。別の五分の一が解決策を提案した。俺はさっそくピースフルな笑顔を向けた。
lines.english: Yes, of course. Surely she would understand if we talked. Her eyes were so beautiful. There were no bad people anywhere. Another fifth proposed this solution, and I immediately gave her my most peaceable smile.

lines.japanese: にこっ！
lines.english: I beamed.

lines.japanese: 「聞いてるんですか、千歳さん！」
lines.english: “Are you listening, Mr. Chitose!?”

lines.japanese: 「すすすすいません！」
lines.english: “I-I-I'm sorry!”

lines.japanese: 駄目だ、全然解決しそうもない。
lines.english: No. This did not appear to be resolving anything.

lines.japanese: 「あああのすいません、俺そろそろ着替えてこなくちゃいけないんで……」
lines.english: “Um, I'm sorry, but I really ought to go change now...”

lines.japanese: 俺はとりあえず逃げることにした。
lines.english: For the moment, I elected to flee.

lines.japanese: 「いいからまずは私の話を聞いてください」
lines.english: “First, you are going to listen to what I have to say.”

lines.japanese: しかし回りこまれてしまった。ああもう、こうなったら最後の手段！　必殺、アルティメット・エスケイプ！
lines.english: But she circled around and blocked me. Damn it. In that case, my final resort! Finishing move: Ultimate Escape!

lines.japanese: 「ごめんトイレ行かせて」
lines.english: “Sorry, let me use the bathroom.”

lines.japanese: が、それは火に油を注ぐ結果となった。
lines.english: This merely poured oil on the fire.

lines.japanese: 「あなたはいつも口を開けばトイレトイレと。トイレのことしか頭にないんですか！」
lines.english: “Whenever you open your mouth, it's bathroom this and bathroom that! Is that the only thing in your head?”

lines.japanese: 「その辺でしてきなさいっ！」
lines.english: “Then go do it outside!”

lines.japanese: 「野外放尿プレイ！？」
lines.english: “An outdoor-pissing fetish!?”

lines.japanese: そのあと玉泉日和子の説教が続いたので、けっきょく俺の遅刻は倍加してしまった。
lines.english: Hiyoko Tamaizumi kept lecturing me, and in the end I was twice as late.

lines.japanese: るふう！　やつさえいなければもっと早く始業できたものを、あのコケコケうるさいコカトリス女めが！
lines.english: Rrrgh! Without her, I could have started work much sooner. Damn that cluck-clucking cockatrice woman!

lines.japanese: 「ちっきしょー、ひよねーちゃんめ。そいだら仕返ししちゃるもんねー」
lines.english: “Darn that Hiyo! Then I'm gonna get her back!”

lines.japanese: 俺は油性ペンで彼女のネームプレートの頭一文字を四角で囲って、苗字を国泉に変えておいた。
lines.english: With a permanent marker, I boxed in the first character on her nameplate, turning the *tama* in Tamaizumi into the *kuni* in Kunizumi.

lines.japanese: 「勇猛の舞姫ー、ドリブラックー」
lines.english: “Dancing Princess of Valor—Dori Black!”

lines.japanese: 「慈愛の女神ー、ドリホワイトー」
lines.english: “Goddess of Compassion—Dori White!”

lines.japanese: 「ふたりはー、アレキサンドリアー」
lines.english: “Together, we are Alexandria!”

lines.japanese: 汚名をそそぐべくフロアできびきび働いてたら、なんだか楽しそうな放送が流れてきた。
lines.english: As I worked briskly on the floor to wipe the stain from my name, a remarkably cheerful broadcast began playing.

lines.japanese: おお、なんだおい、楽しそうじゃないか。俺も入れてくれないかなあ。
lines.english: Oh! This sounded like fun. I wondered if they would let me join in.

lines.japanese: しかしこんな楽しそうなラジオドラマなのに、玉泉トレーナーのこめかみはピクピク震えていた。
lines.english: Yet for all the merry radio drama, Hiyoko's temple was visibly twitching.

lines.japanese: 「あの、千歳さん」
lines.english: “Um, Mr. Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 「んー？　どうした、玉泉のひと」
lines.english: “Hm? What is it, Hiyoko?”

lines.japanese: 意識の制御を取りもどした俺は、先刻の決意どおり、玉泉日和子とはある程度くだけた口調で接することにしていた。
lines.english: Having regained control of my awareness, I had begun addressing Hiyoko Tamaizumi with a degree of casual familiarity, exactly as resolved.

lines.japanese: 「私、先に休憩に入ってもいいですか」
lines.english: “May I take my break first?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ。べつにいいけど」
lines.english: “Sure. That's fine.”

lines.japanese: 彼女はふらふらと階段を上っていった。まあ、あの性格からしてこの放送には耐えられないよなあ。鷲介のころに見聞きした記憶がそう結論付けた。
lines.english: She climbed the stairs unsteadily. Given her personality, she could never endure that broadcast. My memories of observing her during Shusuke's time reached that conclusion.

lines.japanese: じゃあなんでここでアルバイトしてんの、あいつ。鷲介じゃない誰かが尋ねた。
lines.english: Then why does she work here? someone other than Shusuke asked.

lines.japanese: 「ん？　たしかに……なんでだろう」
lines.english: “Hm. That's a good question... Why?”

lines.japanese: 小金が欲しいだけなら、さっさと他の働き口探してるよな……金以外に、なんかここで働きたい理由でもあるのかな。
lines.english: If she merely needed a little money, she would have found another job long ago... Was there some reason besides money that made her want to work here?

lines.japanese: いつか機会があれば聞いてみようかなと思った。
lines.english: I thought I might ask her if the opportunity ever arose.

lines.japanese: 「あー、ずっとしゃべりっぱだと疲れんなー。おー千歳ー、肩揉んで」
lines.english: “Ahh, talking nonstop really tires you out. Hey, Chitose, rub my shoulders.”

lines.japanese: 「千歳くん今日は来てるんだー。やっぽーん、おつかれー！」
lines.english: “Oh, Chitose is here today! Yappooon! Good work!”

lines.japanese: 「やあ、英里子さんのひとに紀奈子さんのひとじゃないですか」
lines.english: “Why, if it isn't Eriko and Kinako.”

lines.japanese: 玉泉日和子と入れ違いに下りてきたアレックス２。このふたりは俺がちょっとぐらい欠勤しても、こまかく詮索してこないから楽でいい。
lines.english: Alex Two came downstairs as Hiyoko Tamaizumi went up. These two were easy company. If I missed a day or two, they did not pry into every detail.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、たまひよ休憩入んの？　はあ、相変わらずひとりが好きなやつだね」
lines.english: “Oh, Tama-chick's going on break? Man, she really does love being alone.”

lines.japanese: 「もー、えりちゃんったら、またひよちゃんのことそんな風に言ってー。聞いてよ千歳君、昨日だって酷いんだよ」
lines.english: “Come on, Eri. Don't talk about Hiyo that way again. Listen, Chitose. She was awful yesterday too.”

lines.japanese: 「なーんで、私なにも間違ったことは言ってないでしょ。私だけが悪いみたいに言わないでくださいよ」
lines.english: “Why? I didn't say anything wrong. Don't talk like everything was my fault.”

lines.japanese: ふうーん。俺がいない間も玉泉日和子と日野英里子は、なんやかんやと鞘当てしてたんだ。
lines.english: Hmm. So while I was away, Hiyoko Tamaizumi and Eriko Hino had continued crossing blades over one thing or another.

lines.japanese: まあでも、どうせいつもと同じで、日野英里子が一方的に玉泉日和子を責めたてる構図だったんだろう。言葉きっついからなあ、日野英里子。
lines.english: Still, it had presumably followed the usual pattern, with Eriko Hino attacking Hiyoko Tamaizumi entirely one-sidedly. Eriko Hino had a vicious tongue.

lines.japanese: ふむん。そういえば彼女のプチ暴言やプチ暴力には、たびたび鷲介も男としての尊厳を辱められてきたのだったな……。
lines.english: Hrm. Come to think of it, her petty abuse and petty violence had repeatedly affronted Shusuke's masculine dignity as well...

lines.japanese: ようし。今日は玉泉トレーナーの仇討ちも含めて、ブランニュー俺がプチ報復を敢行しちゃうぞ！　さてさて、なにか平和的に恥辱の罰を与える手段はないものか……。
lines.english: Very well. Today, partly to avenge Hiyoko, the brand-new me would carry out a little retaliation! Now, then. Was there some peaceful way to pay her back for all that humiliation...?

lines.japanese: 「ま、たまひよはいいか。おー千歳、うちらの放送聞いた？　どう私の演技」
lines.english: “Well, forget Tama-chick. Hey, Chitose, did you hear our broadcast? How was my acting?”

lines.japanese: 「演技。え、あの、ふたりはチキンドリアとかのこと？　いや、どうもこうも、まず演技を論じるレベルに達してないでしょう」
lines.english: “Acting? You mean that thing about the two of you being chicken doria? What did I think? It has not yet reached a level at which its acting can be discussed.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なに千歳、私の演技が分からないなんてセンスのないやつだね」
lines.english: “What? Chitose, anyone who can't understand my acting has no taste.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、何をおっしゃる。でしたら次は、俺に主役をやらせてごらんなさい。全柳木原を感動の渦に巻きこんでみせますとも。だって夢テレビじゃおれ一人で全役やってたからよー、おしばいはカンペキだで」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! What are you saying? Let me play the lead next time, and I shall sweep all Yanagihara into a maelstrom of emotion. I played every part myself on Dream TV, so I'm real good at acting.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあ私が主題歌歌うー！」
lines.english: “Oh! Then I'll sing the theme song!”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、それも俺が」
lines.english: “No, I shall do that as well.”

lines.japanese: 「えー！　そんなの職権濫用だよ。なんで主役が歌まで歌うの？」
lines.english: “What!? That's abuse of authority. Why does the lead get to sing too?”

lines.japanese: 「えーと実はですね、次の演目はミュージカル仕立てなんですよ。そう、それだ」
lines.english: “Well, you see, the next production will be a musical. Yes. That is it.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、歌って踊れるってやつ？　てゆーか千歳、踊れんの？」
lines.english: “Oh, one of those singing-and-dancing things? Wait, Chitose, can you even dance?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　踊れるっつうの。たりめーだろ、タイやヒラメも手のひらで舞いおどらせちゃうぐれー、めちゃめちゃ踊れるっつうの。おう、じゃあよ、付け睫毛のあんたにも役やるよ。ええと、尻子玉を抜く河童の役」
lines.english: “Huh? Course I can dance. Obviously. I can make sea bream and flounder dance in the palm of my hand—that's how fucking well I dance. Tell you what, Fake Lashes: I'll give you a role too. You can be a river goblin that yanks people's soul-orbs out through their asses.”

lines.japanese: 「うん？　千歳、ケンカ売ってる？」
lines.english: “Hm? Chitose, are you picking a fight?”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、いいとも！　受けてたつぞ日野英里子！　もう御託はいい、どちらが華麗に舞えるか、男同士いさぎよくフリーダンスバトルだ！　ルールは情け無用のデスマッチ、会場はここ、審査員は望月紀奈子！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Gladly! I accept your challenge, Eriko Hino. Enough chatter. Let us settle which of us can dance more magnificently in an honorable, man-to-man freestyle dance battle! Rules: no-mercy death match. Venue: here. Judge: Kinako Mochizuki!”

lines.japanese: 「んー、よかっぺよー」
lines.english: “Mm, works for me.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！　言っとくけど私、友達と本格的なダンスの練習したことあるからね。真面目にやったらフツーに上手いよ」
lines.english: “Hah! Just so you know, I've practiced serious dance routines with my friends. When I actually try, I'm pretty good.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、マジっすか」
lines.english: “Wait, seriously?”

lines.japanese: 「ふふん、私は仲間内でダンシングクイーン英里子と呼ばれていてよ」
lines.english: “Hmph. Among my friends, I am known as Eriko the Dancing Queen.”

lines.japanese: 「や、やばいな、それなら俺も本気でかからないと……」
lines.english: “Th-this is bad. I'll have to take you seriously...”

lines.japanese: 俺は大袈裟に怯んでみせた。勝負はもう始まっているのだ。心理戦という名の勝負が。
lines.english: I made an exaggerated show of recoiling. The contest had already begun: the contest known as psychological warfare.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ次の曲が変わったらスタートね」
lines.english: “Okay, we'll start when the song changes.”

lines.japanese: 「ようし、それなら俺が選曲してやろう」
lines.english: “Very well! Then I shall select the music.”

lines.japanese: いつの間にやら軽部氏がテーブルを組みあわせて即席のお立ち台を作っていた。例によって他のスタッフやお客さんたちには、名物店長のお遊びを止める気などさらさら見られない。
lines.english: At some point, Karube had pushed tables together into an improvised go-go platform. As usual, neither the other staff nor the customers showed the slightest inclination to stop the famous manager's games.

lines.japanese: もはは。文字通り、舞台は整ったようだな。
lines.english: Mohaha. The stage was quite literally set.

lines.japanese: 「いいだろう、こうなったら生半可なお遊戯ステップじゃ決着はつくまい。ヘイ、ＤＪカルベ！　ＢＰＭ２００オーバーの超高速ドラムンベースを用意してくれ！」
lines.english: “Very well. Halfhearted playground steps will never settle matters now. Hey, DJ Karube! Give me ultrafast drum and bass at over two hundred BPM!”

lines.japanese: 俺は準備運動代わりに、タカシがゲーセンで鍛えたバタバタステップをその場で数秒ばかり披露した。はん、と不敵に微笑む自称ダンシングクィーン。よしよし、デモンストレーションはこんなもんか。
lines.english: As a warm-up, I demonstrated a few seconds of the frantic footwork Takashi had honed at the arcade. The self-proclaimed Dancing Queen gave a fearless snort. Good. That would do for the demonstration.

lines.japanese: そして靴を脱いだ俺と日野英里子は、特設ステージにのぼって静かに対峙した。
lines.english: Eriko Hino and I removed our shoes, mounted the special stage, and silently faced one another.
“All right, here we go! Three, two, one...”

lines.japanese: ＤＪカルベのオーバーリアクションと共に、スピーカーから怒涛のハイスピードミュージックが放たれた。
lines.english: With an extravagant flourish from DJ Karube, a torrent of high-speed music exploded from the speakers.

lines.japanese: 「よし、見ろこのフットワーク！　まずツーステップ！」
lines.english: “All right! Watch this footwork! First, the two-step!”

lines.japanese: 目を光らせ、腕を振りみだし、渾身の得意顔で跳ねおどるクィーン英里子。
lines.english: Eyes blazing, arms flailing, Queen Eriko bounded and danced with every ounce of triumphant self-satisfaction she possessed.

lines.japanese: 対する俺は──
lines.english: As for me—

lines.japanese: 「あ、そだ仕事しなきゃ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. I have work to do.”

lines.japanese: ──さっさとステージを下りた。
lines.english: —I promptly climbed off the stage.

lines.japanese: 「おやっ？　見て見て皆さん、なにやら机の上でひとりドタバタ跳ねまわってるひとがいるよ？」
lines.english: “Oh? Look, everyone! Somebody's hopping around all by herself on top of a table!”

lines.japanese: そして他人事のように指を差した。
lines.english: I pointed at her as though I had nothing to do with the situation.

lines.japanese: 「うわーホントだ、えりちゃんカッコいー」
lines.english: “Wow, you're right! Eri looks so cool!”

lines.japanese: 「うむ、さすが練習しただけあって、いいフットワークだな」
lines.english: “Indeed. As one would expect from all that practice, her footwork is excellent.”

lines.japanese: なんともお寒い気圧が観衆の上に停滞していた。ぱち、ぱち……と逆に辛くなる程度のまばらな拍手。どこかのテーブルから「ママー、あれなーにー」「しっ、見ちゃいけません」という声が聞こえた。
lines.english: A bitter cold front stalled over the audience. Scattered applause—clap... clap...—so sparse it made the spectacle more painful. From one table came a child's ‘Mommy, what's that?’ and a mother's ‘Shh. Don't look.’

lines.japanese: 檀上では真っ赤になったクィーンがこぶしを握りしめて立ちつくしていた。
lines.english: On the platform, the crimson-faced queen stood rigid, both fists clenched.

lines.japanese: 「あれっ、もう踊らないんですか？」
lines.english: “Hm? Are you finished dancing?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ日野君、気持ちは分かるが器物破損は困るぞ。さあ一緒に片付けを手伝いなさい」
lines.english: “Miss Hino, I understand how you feel, but I cannot permit damage to store property. Come, help me put everything back.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、じゃあ私も手伝いまーす」
lines.english: “Oh, I'll help too!”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、おふたりは良いのですよ。遊び道具は遊んだひとが片付ければ良いのです。てことで女王、あとお願いしまーす」
lines.english: “No, no. You two needn't trouble yourselves. Whoever played with the toys should put them away. And so, Your Majesty, we'll leave the rest to you.”

lines.japanese: 日野英里子はとても悔しそうに、華麗なステップあらため地団駄を踏んでいた。
lines.english: Eriko Hino, looking profoundly frustrated, transformed her elegant steps into a furious stamping tantrum.

lines.japanese: もはは。積年の借りは返したぞ“壊し屋”よ。めでたしめでたし。
lines.english: Mohaha. I had repaid my years of debt to the ‘Destroyer.’ And they all lived happily ever after.

lines.japanese: でもあとが怖いから、いちおう片付けは手伝った。弱ぇー。う、うるさいよ。あーコラー、おまいら自分同士でケンカすんなてー。
lines.english: Still, I was afraid of what might come later, so I helped clean up. Weak. Sh-shut up. Hey, hey, quit fighting with yourselves.

lines.japanese: 「おお、玉泉のひと、休憩は終わったのか。聞いてくれ、おまえの仇は討っておいたぞ」
lines.english: “Ah, Tamaizumi. Is your break over? Listen: I avenged you.”

lines.japanese: 日野英里子とふたりでテーブルを元の位置へ戻しながら、俺は無愛想な鬼教官に勝利を捧げた。
lines.english: As Eriko Hino and I returned the tables to their original positions, I dedicated my victory to the surly demonic instructor.

lines.japanese: ははは、礼ならいらないぞ玉泉日和子。これはちょっぴり迷惑をかけてしまったおまえへの気持ちだ。いやいや、だから礼はいいってば。いいよ、わざわざこっち来なくても。いや、来なくても──
lines.english: Ha ha ha. No thanks were necessary, Hiyoko Tamaizumi. This was my gesture after causing you a little trouble. No, no, I said you needn't thank me. You needn't come all the way over. No, really—

lines.japanese: ──呼んでないのに、なぜか玉泉日和子は俺を睨みながら、肩をいからせ一直線にこちらへやってきた。
lines.english: Without being summoned, Hiyoko Tamaizumi marched straight toward me, shoulders squared, glaring all the way.

lines.japanese: 「この国泉っていうのは千歳さんですか！」
lines.english: “Mr. Chitose! Is this *Kunizumi* your doing!?”

lines.japanese: 「忘れてた！」
lines.english: “I forgot about that!”

lines.japanese: そのあとたっぷり３０分（俺の休憩持ち時間）説教を喰らいました。
lines.english: After that, she spent a full thirty minutes lecturing me—my entire allotted break.
